title: C-52 (cipher machine)
text: The (Hagelin) C-52 and CX-52 were cipher machines manufactured by Crypto AG starting 1951/1952. These pin-and-lug type cipher machines were advanced successors of the C-38/M-209. The machine measures 8 1/2in × 5 3/8in × 4 3/8in. The device is mechanical, but when combined with an electric keyboard attachment, the B-52, the resultant system is termed the BC-52. The B-52 is larger, measuring 12 1/2in × 8 1/2in × 6 3/8in.

title: Zazie dans le Métro
text: Zazie in the Metro (original French title: Zazie dans le Métro, sometimes called "Zazie") is a 1960 French film directed by Louis Malle, based on the novel by Raymond Queneau.

title: Goshen, Kentucky
text: Goshen is a home rule-class city in Oldham County, Kentucky, in the United States. The population was 907 at the 2000 census.
